title: A Vibe holding a film they have not seen, and one whose saved viewing contradicts a standing liked
exists_for: U1 an unseen member is a candidate, never evidence
U2 an unseen film is not a core
U3 their word that they have seen it
construction_note: Night Shift is anchored on Thief (1981), seen and loved. Heat (1995) is in it as want-to-see (unseen before My List), with no verdict: a candidate for that evening, never evidence of what they like, never a core. Collateral (2004) is in it with a saved viewing of want-to-see and a standing liked — two things they said that disagree: for recommending the liked stands and the film is not new; as a core the store refuses it, and only their word changes the viewing. Drive (2011) is an ordinary seen, liked member.

genres.name: Night Crime
genres.instruction: Crime that happens after dark, in cities that don't sleep. Slow is fine, cold is fine, cruel is not.

genres.name: Professionals
genres.instruction: People who are very good at a dangerous job, and the quiet of watching them do it.

vibes.name: Night Shift
vibes.instruction: One long night, one job, and somebody who does it properly.
